privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft. The final text will be published after legal review.
privacy.notCollectText: We don't ask for your real name, phone number or address. Your Telegram name and photo are not stored.
privacy.deleteText: You can delete your data at any time: Profile → "Delete my data".
privacy.contactText: If you have questions, message the Eco-Master bot.
privacy.marketText: If you add a listing, 1–3 photos of the item, its name and description are stored. Location and camera data are removed from the photos. A moderator checks every listing first; once approved, app users see it with your nickname. Items are handed over only at a handover point, through adults — your contacts are never shown to anyone. When you delete the listing or your account, the photos are deleted too.
privacy.classesText: You join a class through the teacher's QR code only yourself and can leave at any time. The teacher sees only the nicknames, levels and points of the class; there is no messaging. The weekly league also shows only nicknames and points.
privacy.collectText: Your Telegram ID, the nickname and avatar you choose, your language and your activity in the app (points, completed tasks).
privacy.whyText: To count your points, show the rating and, if you allow it, send reminders and the week's results.
privacy.whoText: Only your nickname and avatar are shown in the rating. The picture for Stories carries no nickname. Your data is not used for advertising and is never sold.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draft: Draft. The final text will be published after legal review.
terms.aboutText: Eco-Master is a free educational app that teaches how to sort waste and make useful things from it. There are no ads or payments in the app.
terms.whoText: The app is for schoolchildren, teachers and parents. If you're a student, use it with your parents' or teacher's knowledge.
terms.safetyText: Follow the safety marks on projects: 🟡 work only with an adult watching, and 🔴 work is done by adults only. Be careful with sharp, hot and electrical things.
terms.nicknameText: Your nickname must not contain a real name, a phone number or rude words. If the rules are broken, the team may hide the nickname, ask for a new one or block the account.
terms.pointsText: Points are for the game and have no money value. Play fair: points gained by cheating will be cancelled.
terms.contentText: The videos, texts and pictures in the app belong to the Eco-Master team. You may use them in lessons for educational purposes.
terms.changesText: If these terms change, we'll let you know in the app or through the bot.
terms.contactText: If you have questions, message the Eco-Master bot.
terms.marketText: List only things you made yourself or your own things you no longer need — things from home only with your parents' permission. No people, names or addresses in photos, and no contacts in the text. Not allowed: food, medicine, cosmetics, sharp or dangerous things, batteries and electronics, animals, money and valuables. Things are given away for free and only through a handover point; selling or asking for money is not allowed. Listings that break the rules are removed.

rules.title: Market rules
rules.intro: To keep the market safe for everyone:
rules.rule1: Photograph only the item: no people, faces, names, addresses or school names.
rules.rule2: Don't write phone numbers, @usernames or links — children don't contact each other directly.
rules.rule3: Things are handed over only at a handover point, through adults. Never meet anyone on your own.
rules.rule4: Not allowed: food, medicine, cosmetics, sharp or dangerous things, batteries and electronics, animals, money and valuables.
rules.rule5: A moderator checks every listing; only then can others see it.
